title: Arena mutation-testing report
description: Result of applying the operators in operators.json to a reference backend and rerunning the judge. This report measures GATE COVERAGE (does the judge catch broken backends), not candidate correctness.

gate_coverage_ppm.description: killed / (killed + survived) in parts-per-million, EXCLUDING equivalent/build_error/timeout from the denominator. This is a judge-gate-coverage ratio. It is NOT a formal-correctness percentage.

killed_by_gate.description: obligation id of the gate that failed, when killed

equivalence_evidence.description: why reclassified equivalent (oracle agreement on held-out set)

disclaimer.const: Gate coverage is not formal correctness. A high kill ratio means the judge's gates catch these injected faults; it says nothing about soundness of an admitted proof, which rests on the formal certificate and axiom audit. Surviving equivalent mutants are expected and excluded.
